notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.notes: Since there is only one day left for release I wanted to give a little background about the development. Hotel Anatolia is a new  developer's first step into developing games. It has about two hours of content, it doesn’t promise you a Game of The Year experience though it has enough content to make it worth your time. Due to Hotel Anatolia being first game of a developer it has a very accessible price so that you can give feedback easily and support the game with your feedback. I thank everyone who supported the game during its development and strongly urge you to give feedback via e-mail and/or steam reviews.
